nuggets.text: The Owls held West Georgia to 0-for-12 on third downs in a 47-0 season-opening shutout.
The 47-0 win over West Georgia was the Owls' first shutout since a 14-0 win over North Carolina A&T in 2021.
The Owls ran for 240 yards in the first half against West Georgia, beating their FBS-era record for a full game.
The Owls have won eight straight home games, including all seven under head coach Jerry Mack.
Jerry Mack took over a 2-10 Owls team and won the Conference USA title and league Coach of the Year in his first season.
Before coming to Kennesaw State, Jerry Mack coached running backs at Tennessee and for the Jacksonville Jaguars.
Rickie Collins completed all seven passes he threw in two seasons at LSU, then played at Syracuse before joining the Owls.
Rickie Collins hit 18 of 23 passes in his Owls debut, a 78.3% rate that led Conference USA.
The Owls did not play their first football game until 2015, beating East Tennessee State 56-16.
Triston Morgan blocked a punt against West Georgia and was named Conference USA Special Teams Player of the Week.
